description: This file defines the Api class, which extends DataGroup, representing API-related data with attributes for API name and module. It includes methods for construction, creating instances from an array, and accessing its properties.

classes.name: Api
classes.description: Represents an API data group with properties for API name and module, providing construction and array-based instantiation methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an Api instance with name, description, API identifier, module, allowed permission, and permissions array.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an Api instance from an array of data, including permissions validation and instantiation.
